name: siteground-deploy
description: Gets a Node.js project live on SiteGround step by step: fit check, GitHub auto-deploy or ZIP upload, every dashboard click explained (environment variables, database, cron, SSH key, HTTPS, domain and DNS), automatic verification over SSH, plus a SiteGround vs. Railway comparison. German and English. Unofficial, not affiliated with SiteGround. Created by Sertac · NetBoosting GmbH (https://netboosting.de).
